keyEvents.text: Kristoffer Haugen (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Viking 0, Sabah 1. Orphé Mbina (Sabah) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Umarali Rakhmonaliev following a fast break.
Gianni Stensness (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Viking 1, Sabah 1. Erik Botheim (Viking) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kristoffer Haugen with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Veljko Simic (Sabah).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sabah. Joy-Lance Mickels replaces Veljko Simic because of an injury.
Umarali Rakhmonaliev (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Viking. Herman Haugen replaces Henrik Heggheim.
Substitution, Viking. Peter Christiansen replaces Henrik Bjørdal.
Substitution, Viking. Vetle Auklend replaces Kristoffer Haugen.
Penalty saved. Zlatko Tripic (Viking) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Stas Pokatilov (Sabah).
Goal! Viking 2, Sabah 1. Zlatko Tripic (Viking) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Sabah. Xayal Aliyev replaces Orphé Mbina.
Substitution, Sabah. Du Queiroz replaces Christian Nwachukwu.
Substitution, Sabah. Xander Severina replaces Abdulla Xaybulayev.
Delay in match because of an injury Peter Christiansen (Viking).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Aden McCarthy (Sabah) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Sabah. Rahman Dasdamirov replaces Umarali Rakhmonaliev.
Goal! Viking 3, Sabah 1. Henrik Falchener (Viking) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Zlatko Tripic with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Viking. Niklas Fuglestad replaces Simen Kvia-Egeskog.
Substitution, Viking. Jakob Hansen replaces Tobias Moi.
Joy-Lance Mickels (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Viking 4, Sabah 1. Erik Botheim (Viking) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Peter Christiansen.
